headline: Oil tops $100 as strikes on Iran enter a fourteenth night
summary: Brent crude passed one hundred dollars for the first time since May as US strikes continued and Houthi forces hit Saudi tankers in the Red Sea.
script: Oil passed one hundred dollars a barrel for the first time since May. U.S. Central Command completed a thirteenth straight night of strikes on Iran. Iran hit back at bases in Bahrain, Kuwait and Jordan.
